effects.effect: Whenever you take the first [turn](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/turn) in a combat encounter, you can use a main action to introduce yourself and your allies to your opponents. Each ally can [shift](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/shifting) up to their [speed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/speed), and [ability rolls](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/ability-roll) made against them have a double [bane](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/bane) until the end of the [combat round](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/combat-round). Additionally, any [surprised](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/surprised) enemy is no longer [surprised](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/surprised).
